title: Tokimi's Ruined Mod
description: A mod created by Tokimi that has his viewers Dumb Ideas.
body:
# Tokimi's Ruined Mod

Check out the original YouTube video here:

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/TnsxCDDu4Xg" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Features:

- Poop Weapon
- Exploding Foot
- Flying/Exploding Pigs
- Creepers Open Doors
- Cannibalism
- Subscribeling

Everything is configurable within the config menu if you have [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) and [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) installed

**NOTICE: This mod is not to be taken seriously and probably has bugs. It is not meant to be in modpacks or installed alongside other mods. Just be cautious!**

Shoutout to Knarfy for the original idea.
